QuestInfo.name: The Mock Training
QuestInfo.1: Listen to Neinheart explain the Mock Training.
QuestInfo.2: Sounds like Neinheart approves of your capabilities based on the Mock Training.

0.0: You performed admirably on that test. Perhaps I'll be able to use you for more than cannon fodder.\r\n#L0##bWhat test? Is the Empress safe?#l\n#k
0.1: The Master of Disguise test is one of my favorite methods for testing new recruits.\r\n#L0##bWhat?!#l\n#k
0.2: A true prodigy would have seen through the ruse, but we can't all be geniuses. You proved yourself able to solve complex problems. Shall I tell you more?

yes.0: I will explain, if you'd like.

no.0: A knight should always ask questions.

1.0: Once, some time ago, the Black Mages did infiltrate our ranks. It was their master of disguise, and it caused quite a stir.
1.1: However, the Chief Knights were more than a match, as I had calculated they would be. The treasures that were stolen were recovered with no incident.
1.2: The ordeal has proved quite useful as a teaching tool. It is at once a lesson to never let down your guard, and a useful test of lateral thinking. Any knight who completes it has proven themselves able to handle rapidly-changing situations, and thus capable of operating in the field. Expect your first mission shortly.
